brief: THE BET. Expect and welcome a 150-300 line diff; this is not a polish job. Measured on HEAD this pass (seed 42, warp 625): the courtyard's paved annulus between the ring bed and the edge beds is 1,896 PATH cells running r 13.8 to 37.8 off the linden — 15.6% of the world's 12,144 cells, the largest single-tile ground surface in the town, against the plaza's 730 PATH and the river's 920 WATER. Everything standing on it is four BENCH_SPOTS. The plaza, a third the size, carries a fountain, a roundel, pits, six benches, six fount stands, two crumb spots, a rail, five bollards and a fourteen-place door. Give the courtyard a COVERED WALK: an arcade along the inside face of one range of the surrounding block, so that the garden has a roofed edge you can be under. The recommended shape is the one GLASS (#116) and LEADS (#170) already proved — a tile of its own with its own fill in the ground cache, so that the floor reads as roofed ground you see UNDER, and WALL to buildVolumes() so the range's own roof extends over it rather than a new roof being invented (trap b: change a footprint, never a roof). Pick the range yourself and say why you picked it: the north range is drawn behind the whole garden and the south range is drawn nearest and largest, and that is a real trade you should make with a screenshot, not with an argument. It must be USED: in rain, people in the courtyard should shelter under it rather than only leaving by lawnGate (#179), and a walk under a colonnade is a stop that can perform and say something like every other visit in this town.
successLooksLike: In the wide shot at 1600x950 AND at 390x844 the courtyard has a roofed walk down one side with its own shadow line, and in rain there are figures standing under it. In the census: tileKinds 162 -> 171 in ALL THREE ages (this is the obligation ICE could not meet — see b187 and the watch note), `structures` up by the arcade's own count, EDGE_BEDS still 204, `green` and `planted` within the 2% cross-seed noise floor. Re-pin with `census.mjs --save-baseline` and SAY SO in the ledger.
avoid: Do not eat the edge beds — 523 BED cells and EDGE_BEDS 204 carry the planting CA, and paying for the arcade with them turns a 4b into a swap. Do not put it across the four gateway approaches (`nearEntrance`). Do not brief yourself into a texture job: PATH.court is sd/mean 0.143, mid-table, and the surface is NOT the problem — occupancy is. Do not add a second tree; matureTrees is a census field and the linden is the courtyard's one landmark.
